description: ACT Government publishes this point inventory of municipal assets in the Australian Capital Territory. Subtypes include intake pumps, recirculation pumps and water pumps. The provider describes attributes for pump purpose, asset subtype, make and model, location and ownership. Assets are captured through works-as-executed handover or field audits. Coverage is limited to assets owned or managed by the named ACT government services; private, federal and other directorate assets may be absent. The Socrata catalogue and JSON view metadata are public and free to inspect. The native listing does not state a licence. Caveats: only metadata was inspected, no dataset rows or geometry values were downloaded. Field definitions do not establish field completeness or current asset condition. For infrastructure simulation, pump locations and types can identify pumping components; pump curves, operating schedules and hydraulic capacity are not established. Related catalogue: ACT Government open data portal.
